paper_title: Strong constraints on decay and annihilation of dark matter from heating of gas-rich dwarf galaxies
notes: Extracted from Figure 4 (left panel) showing ALP-photon coupling constraints from Leo T dwarf galaxy gas heating. The limit curve (black solid line labeled 'Leo T gas temp.') represents upper bounds on g_aγγ as a function of axion mass m_a. Coordinates extracted via pymupdf vector path analysis with axis calibration: x_axis uses 5-point log-linear fit for mass ticks (10, 50, 100, 500, 1000 eV); y-axis uses 7-point calibration for exponent ticks (10^-15 through 10^-9 GeV^-1). Curve simplified using Ramer-Douglas-Peucker algorithm (epsilon=0.01 in log-log space) from 398 initial pixels to 16 data points. The very first 4 extracted points (with anomalous high coupling values) were discarded as noise/legend artifacts before simplification. Mass range: 32.8 eV to 3353 eV.
